decisions.reason: The crate builds on existing reusable container and agricultural customer knowledge, enabling the firm to assimilate early results and improve it.
As a foldable large container, it aligns closely with core returnable packaging expertise and shows strong early website visibility, making drop unlikely.
A standard stackable plastic crate is central to the firm's existing product knowledge and can be readily improved through learning.
Rackable pallets draw on established pallet design and manufacturing capabilities, allowing effective interpretation of early market feedback.
Despite added spill-retention requirements, the firm's rubber and plastic pallet knowledge supports assimilation and development.
Plastic pallets with load retainers extend existing pallet competence, and in-house R&D provides the absorptive capacity to learn and improve.
